scope: Second optimization pass: saved-symbol browsing, organization validation/staff editing, and ORBAT selection; visual polish and theme customization remain deferred.
changes: Keep one completed definition and SVG per mounted thumbnail. Reuse it on returning to view; invalidate when the saved content version or render input changes. Preserve cancellation and stale-response protection.
Memoize unchanged organization validation and comparisons, and serialize the saved baseline only when it changes. Actual edits and save commands still validate.
Build the organization diagram only while its ORBAT view is active. Keep the staff return button based on assigned structure rather than on whether a diagram is currently rendered.
Index organization-owned unit identities by node within the assigned ORBAT, preserving headquarters precedence and isolation from retained profiles from other maps.
Initialize SVG unit hit areas and accessibility attributes per rendered diagram, then update only the previous/new selection. Reinitialize on expand/compact and new artwork.
Memoize graphic render-request serialization while its immutable input is unchanged.
Add npm run benchmark:library with actual Electron scrolling, edits, keyboard navigation, expanded diagrams, invalidation and read-only staff return checks.

benchmark.fixture: 30 fictional saved symbols and a 255-unit organization with 254 subordinate profiles and 8 staff roles each (2032 positions).
benchmark.method: Normal offline Electron launch in an isolated workspace; 1500x1000 viewport. Six return-to-card samples and twelve tab/selection/staff-edit samples to the second animation frame. Separate precise-coverage batches for three scroll cycles, six tab switches and five staff edits. A separate six-selection observer counts only unit accessibility attribute writes. No coverage during latency measurements.
limitations: Local development-build timings, not a packaged-release or cold-start speed claim.
Selection latency is near the two-frame floor and changed little; the measured gain is the reduction in DOM work.
Corroborating runs preceded the one-condition return-button correction; final records include that correction.

unitTests.note: Passed with the optimization changes; the subsequent one-condition staff return-button fix was typechecked and verified by both desktop organization workflows.
